data.name: MetadataEnhanceOptions_MetadataCacheMode_Description
data.value: Local TMDB cache: reads override/<type>/<tmdbid> first (your custom JSON, highest priority), then cache/<type>/<tmdbid> (passive, written from online results). Speeds up re-scans and works offline. Default is OFF.

data.name: MetadataEnhanceOptions_MetadataCacheRootFolder_Description
data.value: Root folder for the local TMDB cache/override directories. Required when the mode is not OFF.

data.name: MetadataEnhanceOptions_ClearRecentTmdbCacheOnStartup_Description
data.value: Clear the passive TMDB cache (<root>\cache) at every startup. User overrides and merge patches are kept. Useful right after TMDB corrected a title: the next scrape fetches fresh data instead of hitting the stale cache. Default is OFF.

data.name: MetadataCacheRootFolderNotExist
data.value: Metadata cache root folder is not usable (drive/parent folder missing or not writable).

data.name: MetadataCacheRootFolderRequired
data.value: Please specify a metadata cache root folder before enabling a cache mode.

data.name: MetadataCacheRootFolderNotAllowed
data.value: Metadata cache root folder is not allowed (drive root or system folder).

data.value: Tags HDR Vivid (CUVA) and dual-layer Dolby Vision titles. Both toggles below stop working when this is off. Requires a server restart. Default is OFF.

data.name: MediaInfoExtractOptions_EnableDolbyVisionProfileTagging_Tag_dual_layer_Dolby_Vision_as_Profile_7
data.value: Tag dual-layer Dolby Vision as Profile 7

data.name: MediaInfoExtractOptions_EnableDolbyVisionProfileTagging_Marks_the_1080p_enhancement_layer_as_Profile_7_6__Keep_ON_unless_your_player_mishandles_it_
data.value: Detects dual-layer Dolby Vision (BL + 1080p enhancement layer); Emby then shows Profile 7.6 (Bluray). That is the only Profile 7 label Emby has, and it does not distinguish FEL from MEL. Turn this off if some players fail to play or show a black screen.

data.name: MediaInfoExtractOptions_EnableHdrVividTagging_Detects_CUVA_dynamic_metadata_and_shows_the_video_range_label_as_HDR_Vivid_
data.value: When the source carries CUVA dynamic metadata, the video range label shows as HDR Vivid. CUVA is only present in video frames, not in Emby's probe result, so one extra frame is read for HDR sources (once per item).

data.name: PluginOptions_EnablePlugin_Description
data.value: Disables all plugin behavior. Requires a server restart to take effect. Default is ON.
